Sandbox_JBWorkOrders_WorkEnduranceReduct: Give back this percent of endurance that Work Orders labor costs. 0 = vanilla, 100 = no endurance loss from Work Orders.
Sandbox_JBWorkOrders_RestAtEnduranceLeve: During Work Orders labor, auto-rest until endurance is full once the endurance moodle reaches this level (1-4). 0 = never rest.
